['ArcelorMittal Eisenh\u00fcttenstadt Gm.company_description: ArcelorMittal Eisenhüttenstadt GmbH, formerly known as EKO Stahl, is a steelworks in Eisenhüttenstadt, Brandenburg, Germany. It was established in the early 1950s and has undergone various changes and expansions over the years. The plant produces pig iron, cold-rolled and hot-rolled steel, and has facilities for basic oxygen steelmaking.

['Hamburger Hafen und Logistik AG '].company_description: Hamburger Hafen und Logistik AG, known until 2005 as Hamburger Hafen- und Lagerhaus-Aktiengesellschaft, is a German logistics and transportation company specializing in port throughput and container and transport logistics. It operates in the Port of Hamburg, which is Germany's largest seaport by volume and the third-busiest port in Europe. The company is also associated with the Speicherstadt, the largest warehouse district in the world, located in the port of Hamburg.
